title: Lost Mary BM6000 Berry Apple Peach Prefilled Vape Pods - 20mg
description: Berry Apple Peach offers a bright, multi-layered fruit profile that balances sweet, tangy, and soft notes in equal measure. The blend opens with a mix of Forest Berries and crisp, orchard-fresh Apple, providing a sharp and refreshing introduction. This is smoothed out by the velvety sweetness of ripe Peach on the exhale, creating a rounded and satisfying all-day vape. Designed for use with the Lost Mary BM6000 V2 Prefilled Pod Kit , this pack includes a replaceable 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container, allowing you to refresh your device with ease. This system extends the lifespan of your device, providing up to 6000 puffs while offering the flexibility to switch flavours at any time. How To Setup Lost Mary BM6000 Pod & Refill Step 1 Remove the prefilled pod and refill container from the packaging. Step 2 Remove any safety stickers from the components. Step 3 Insert the pod securely into the device. Step 4 Attach the refill container to the side of the device. Step 5 Turn the device upside down to transfer e-liquid from the refill container to the pod. Step 6 Allow a few minutes for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set! When the pod and refill container are empty, simply replace them with a new set to continue enjoying your Lost Mary BM6000 V2 device. Discover every flavour with our Lost Mary BM6000 refill collection .
